job.job_description:
Full Stack Developer Autonomous Cloud Platform

Location:

Chennai/Nashik


Employment Type:

Full-time


About the Role

We are seeking a versatile and driven Full Stack Developerto work on the development of our Autonomous Cloud Portal. This AI-poweredplatform enables users to discover, provision, and manage cloud workloadsthrough self-service portals integrated with hyperscaler clouds (AWS, Azure,GCP). You will develop microservices and responsive frontends to powerautomated policy management, resource recommendations, and workloaddeployments.


Key Responsibilities
Backend Development (Python / FastAPI)
- Develop RESTful andGraphQL APIs for resource provisioning, workload templates, and automationtriggers.
- Integrate AI-basedrecommendation engines and compliance automation modules.
- Implement secure usermanagement, IAM integrations, and multi-tenant APIs.
Frontend Development (React.js / Tailwind CSS)
- Build self-servicedashboards for AI-driven recommendations, policy management, and workloadinsights.
- Implement responsive andintuitive UI/UX for Autonomous Cloud features like resource provisioning,compliance, and security management.
- Integrate role-basedaccess and multi-layer navigation.
Cloud and AI Integration
- Work with custom cloudAPI for infrastructure management and telemetry ingestion.
- Consume ML APIs forworkload recommendation and autonomous optimization.
- Collaborate on pre-builtworkload template generation and deployment flows.
Agile Collaboration
- Participate in sprintplanning, technical design discussions, and code reviews.
- Collaborate with Product,Cloud Architects, and AI teams for seamless feature delivery.
- Write unit andintegration tests to maintain code quality.


Qualifications

Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science,Engineering, or related field
Experience: 35 years in full stack development roles,ideally with SaaS or Cloud platforms
Backend: Python (FastAPI preferred), Django/Flask optional
Frontend: React.js, Tailwind CSS
Cloud Exposure: AWS, Azure, or GCP SDK/API integrations
DevOps: Basic experience with Docker, GitHub Actions, andCI/CD pipelines
Database: PostgreSQL or similar relational/NoSQL databases
API Integration: RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and third-partyAPI integrations


Nice to Have

- Experience withcloud-native infrastructure automation (Terraform, Pulumi)
- Understanding of AI/MLintegration into enterprise applications
- Familiarity withmulti-tenant SaaS platforms and enterprise auth (OAuth2, SAML)
- Exposure to observabilitytools (Grafana, Prometheus)


Why Join Us

- Work on an AI-powered,autonomous self-service cloud portal used by enterprises.
- Build and scaleintelligent automation features in the cloud ecosystem.
- Collaborate with amultidisciplinary team including AI, Cloud, Product, and DevOps.
